- [LGRA.15.11] **Schemas** with optional lifecycle clause
  (`scope <value>`) **after** the type name, builtin
  types (`String`, `Int`, `Float`, `Bool`, `Json`) ([LGRA.22.8]),
  optional docstring, fields with optional slot markers.
  No `Any`; no composite types (`List`, `Map`). `Json`
  is the fallback for slots whose shape can't be
  statically committed to. Five scope values per
  [LSCP]: `explicit` (default),
  `logical`, `ttl <time_expr>`, `activation`, `ambient`. Bare
  `schema Foo:` is shorthand for `scope explicit`.
